sources.name: Clay Mathematics Institute Millennium Prize Problems
notes: Six problems are listed by Clay as unsolved as of the catalog review date.
Poincare is retained as a resolved benchmark.
Clay recognition rules are separate from mathematical correctness.

sources.name: American Institute of Mathematics Problem Lists
notes: Individual lists can contain solved or stale entries.
Every imported problem requires list-level and literature-level verification.

sources.name: Erdos Problems database
notes: Database status is a research lead, not independent proof that a problem remains open.
Check references and current literature before allocating major effort.

sources.name: MathOverflow open-problems tag
notes: Questions vary in age, scope, precision and current status.
Import only after attribution and statement normalization.

sources.name: Open-problem sections in papers, surveys and conference proceedings
notes: Prefer DOI, arXiv identifier, authors, version and publication date.
Later papers may solve, weaken or reformulate the listed problem.

sources.name: Mathematical competition and benchmark archives
notes: Competition problems are not automatically research-open problems.
They are stored in a distinct ProblemKind and never mixed with open-status counts.

sources.name: Scientific and algorithmic challenge platforms
notes: Deadlines, eligibility, data licenses and AI policies can change.
No automated submission or identity-bound participation.
